subject.title: [Bug]: Anthropic provider disappears from model picker + models list crashes on manually-added Anthropic models + static catalog never pulls new models (Fable 5 / Haiku 4.5)

question: Should Anthropic model discovery remain release-managed, or should the provider plugin browse Anthropic's live model endpoint when suitable direct API credentials are available?
rationale: The crash repair is mechanical, but live model browsing changes network, authentication, caching, freshness, and offline behavior and therefore needs an explicit provider-product decision.

options.title: Add provider-owned browsing
options.body: Use the existing provider catalog/browse seam for direct Anthropic API credentials, merge results with bundled and configured rows, cache safely, and retain an offline catalog fallback.

options.title: Keep release-managed catalogs
options.body: Continue shipping curated entries and forward-compatible runtime resolution, but add a lightweight independently refreshable catalog/update mechanism and clearer stale-catalog diagnostics.

options.title: Track discovery separately
options.body: Close the crash portion as fixed on main and move automatic discovery into a narrower canonical feature issue before implementation.

recommendation.title: Add provider-owned browsing
recommendation.body: Use the existing provider catalog/browse seam for direct Anthropic API credentials, merge results with bundled and configured rows, cache safely, and retain an offline catalog fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history places this contributor near the Anthropic provider and model-catalog integration boundary.
